name: Ashish Kumar Singh
tagline: Systems Programmer • Full-Stack Developer • CS @ NIT Agartala
bio: Third-year Computer Science undergraduate at NIT Agartala (CGPA 8.94) with hands-on experience building production-grade systems in C++ and Node.js. Engineered Trackit, a real-time Linux system monitor parsing the /proc filesystem at sub-second polling intervals with a 1.3% CPU footprint, and Panopteez, a multi-agent metrics pipeline ingesting from containerised C++ agents into PostgreSQL via a Prisma-backed REST API. Currently leading a 50+ member technical club at NIT Agartala.
